description: This file provides utility functions for navigating, reading, and deleting values in nested dictionaries using dot notation and JSONPath-like syntax. It includes functions for parsing paths, retrieving nested values, and deleting nested fields, with a focus on path-based navigation in complex data structures.

methods.name: get_nested_value
methods.description: Retrieves a value from a nested dictionary using dot notation, with optional default.

methods.name: _parse_path_segments
methods.description: Parses a JSONPath-like string into segments using regex.

methods.name: _delete_nested_value_custom
methods.description: Recursively deletes a field from nested data based on path segments.

methods.name: delete_nested_value
methods.description: Deletes a nested field from a dictionary using JSONPath notation, returning a new modified copy.

methods.name: is_nested_path
methods.description: Checks if a path string requires nested handling based on presence of '.' or '['.
